nodes.name: Load Campaign + Niche
nodes.notes: One read per run. Campaign settings - ICP band, thresholds, daily targets, follow-up offsets - all come from here, never from node parameters.

nodes.name: Start Run Record
nodes.notes: Resume bookkeeping: which workflow, which campaign, which execution, and how far it got.

nodes.name: Build Search Terms
nodes.notes: Each output item is one search term. The per-term limit is derived from the campaign daily target so a wide city list does not blow the budget.

nodes.name: Run Scraper (Apify)
nodes.notes: Replaceable. Any endpoint that returns rows lib/normalize.js can read works here - see config/providers.json capability "discovery" and lib/providers/discovery.*.js.

nodes.name: Normalise + Dedupe Batch
nodes.notes: In-memory deduplication. The database is the second wall - resolve_company() matches on the same identity keys.

nodes.name: Resolve Company (dedupe)
nodes.notes: Returns the existing company when any identity key matches, otherwise creates one. Every key seen is recorded, so a later hit on ANY of them lands on the same row.

nodes.name: Suppressed?
nodes.notes: Opt-outs and do-not-contact are checked before a lead is ever created.

nodes.name: Create Lead (SCRAPED)
nodes.notes: unique(campaign_id, company_id) guarantees a business is never queued twice inside one campaign.

nodes.name: Classify Failure
nodes.notes: Uses the same classifier as the test suite: 429 backs off, 5xx retries, 401/422 dead-letters immediately.
